ja277:1.1: In excess of fifty years I lived in
ja277:1.2: A cave on the (mountain) rock, feathered one,
ja277:1.4: Formerly the birds would come to my hand.
ja277:2.1: Now, bird, agitated, why did those birds
ja277:2.3: Not considering me as before, or,
ja277:2.4: Are these not those who lived here a long time?
ja277:3.1: We do know you, we are not deluded,
ja277:3.2: We know he’s not you, and we are not them,
ja277:3.3: Your mind is corrupted against our folk,
ja277:3.4: That’s why we are afraid, Ājīvika.
